market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI $110 HIGH in May. Today (Apr 30) WTI already touched $110+ intraday. May is a full month with Iran tensions ongoing and front-month at $104-108. A May $110 print is highly likely - we're already there in late April. Risk would be sudden de-escalation right at start of May.
assessment.key_uncertainty: If tensions cool drastically before May begins, prices could fade below $110 throughout May.
